title: SPECIAL USE AND SIGN REGULATIONS
previewText: In order to provide for the special cultural needs, convenience, enjoyment, education and recreation of the residents of the area and of the many visitors who are attracted to the Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts, special ground floor level streetscape and sign regulations apply.
